category_title: Low-confidence students requiring constant teacher validation and one-to-one support
scenario_title: Whole-class board work with mathematical sentences
minimal_context: Esther is asked to fill in the addends and total in a blank mathematical sentence on the blackboard using two groups of straws arranged on the table.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: I have explained the problem and arranged the two groups of straws on the table. Esther, please look at the blackboard where I wrote ' + = ' and fill in the addends and the total.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I don't know which number operation to use to solve the problem.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think you should do with the straws?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I cannot tell a story or situation that represents this sentence.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just try your best to write the numbers in the blanks.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands silently at the blackboard and does not respond.)
